text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grawr! Why won't it go away?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! What's with this pimple?! How<n>am I gonna do
interviews and<n>photoshoots lookin' like this?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I gotta get rid of it quick or it'll ruin my<n>wicked,
sinister aura...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should call Mom. I bet she'll<n>know what to
do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy seems to be engaged<n>in a difficult
struggle against skin<n>troubles...
